introduction: Virginia Energy Assistance has separate fuel, crisis and cooling components. Each has its own application window and conditions.
description: Virginia Energy Assistance has separate fuel, crisis and cooling components. Each has its own application window and conditions.

sections.who: The current fuel, crisis and cooling income standard is 150% of federal poverty and a qualifying energy expense. Crisis requires an emergency; cooling requires a specified vulnerable household member.
sections.get: Help can offset heating costs, address eligible heating emergencies or assist with cooling bills and equipment. The component determines covered support.
sections.docs:
• Household income and identity records.
  • Energy account, fuel or equipment information.
  • Emergency notice or vulnerable-member evidence when relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the component

    Review current windows on VDSS Energy Assistance.

  2. Apply

    Use CommonHelp, phone intake at 855-635-4370, or the relevant paper form.

  3. Explain deadlines

    Provide any shutoff or unsafe-equipment details to local DSS.
sections.after: Regular Fuel Assistance intake runs from the second Tuesday in October to the second Friday in November. Confirm other seasonal windows and never assume an application halts disconnection.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using VDSS Energy Assistance. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is one application window used for all help?
Does cooling have an extra household condition?
It requires a specified older, disabled or young household member.
No. DHCD handles separate home-efficiency services.
What if my heat is unsafe?
Ask local DSS about Crisis Assistance and state the immediate problem.
